items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: And yet my first bass player when I came to New York was Jay Leonhart.

ctx.x: Well now actually — or just someone who was clearly not — not getting my groove and not, but you know, then again I’m not — particularly at this time of life I’m not, you know, I’m not so easily destined to be hiring somebody that I don’t know. I might sometime, and I should because it’s always nice to play with other people. But you want your comfort level. And sometimes things go wrong even with them and you get, you know like why did he do that to me. And why did he blah-blah-blah. But still, you know, you’re…
